title: Reconstruct retries and delegated agents as observed rollout branches
narrative: Nubble starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Nubble needs the observed run topology — retries, spawned reviewers, and terminals — as a first-class graph linked back to the intended plan, not only the planned node list. Accepts FineEnvs training-sequence reconstruction[^fineenvs-rollout].
implementation:
`build_rollout_graph`; `CliInstrumentor` verb `rollout_graph_build`.

Acceptance walks the registered CLI verb (TestHarnessCliConfig promotes remaining story probes when no src product verb exists yet).
validation: Harness `user_story` walks the promoted product/test verb (no `probe:` wrapper); hard expects on declared observation keys.
